title: Cryptoassets Standard: Consultation on Return Templates (MA(BS)28 Explanatory Notes)
summary: On 13 June 2025, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) published explanatory notes for banking return MA(BS)28, part of a wider consultation titled 'Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates,' per the document's own title. HKMA's numbered 'MA' returns are standardised periodic reports Authorized Institutions file with HKMA for prudential supervision; explanatory notes are the accompanying guidance on completing a given return. HKMA's document repository returned a server error (HTTP 503) on every attempt to retrieve the full page, both when this card was originally drafted and on repeated independent re-checks since; the specific proposed changes and the consultation's response deadline could not be confirmed against primary source text, and beyond the document's own published title, this summary draws no other claims from the document itself.
why_it_matters: The title alone signals HKMA is folding cryptoasset-specific detail into a routine banking-return template (MA(BS)28) rather than addressing it only through a licensing rule; the consultation's substantive content could not be confirmed against primary source text (see summary). For a newcomer, this is a sign that cryptoasset-related obligations for Hong Kong banks are emerging through everyday prudential-reporting channels, not licensing alone.
